text_block_list.text: Нарита Таисин isn't here today either.

I hear that she hasn't been seen around
the
academy for some time.

While I'm worried about her, she's still
the only
one who can decide whether
she'll continue to
race or not.
So...
choice_data_list: (I'm going to wait here for you.)

text_block_list.text:
I always have and always will believe in
her.
(What should I do now?)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Oh... Taishiiiin! You have a visitor!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: TAISHIN!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ticket... What's gotten into—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Come with me! Now!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The heck? You want me to watch a
basketball
game?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I suuure do!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
There's a player I've been following
lately, and
she's in the starting five in
today's game! It's been
ages since she
started!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I mean, I know you like sports, but did
you have
to drag me into this?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I get really energized when I watch
sports. Like
all, "Yaaah!" Fired up,
y'know what I mean?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: So, well... I figured if you watched too...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You could feel like me and get all...
YAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. Okay, I get you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'll watch the game, so stop yelling
already.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Yay, Taishin! Hehe! I'll turn on the TV!

text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(I'm pretty sure I've seen that player with
the red
hair before.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

Count that basket! With her eleventh

three-pointer, she nails the
buzzer-beater and
clinches the game for
her team!

text_block_list.text: Whoooaaa! That was so, so, so amazing! Woooow!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, Taishin?! The girl with
the red
hair was incredible, right?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
She didn't seem to be doing well last
year, but
then she suddenly got super
good this spring!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: (This spring?)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I mean, come on! No one's rooting for
you! No
one thinks you can win!
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that make you want to give up?
Most
people would...
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's the postgame interview—they're
gonna
talk to her!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: You were amazing on the court!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm glad my training paid off.
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
We heard that you'd been struggling for
some
time—did something snap you out
of it?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm a basketball player, but I
wasn't blessed
with height, as you can
see.
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
I was getting left behind because of my
stature,
and I was in a pretty bad place
this spring.
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give it all up since I figured
no one
expected anything of me, but...
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
Someone gave me the courage not to
give up.
Her way of thinking's a bit odd,
but she's not a
quitter. She's stronger
than anyone I know.
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text: (It's her...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
We don't play the same sport, but she's
the
athlete I admire the most.
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
That's why I decided to show the world
who I
really am—no matter how weak or
pathetic they
might see me!
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
I want to be proud to show everyone the
real me!
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text: Waaah! That's sooo touching!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
What is that? Some passive-aggressive
jab at me?
"Ooh, look at her! She's so
small, but she's trying!
What an
inspiration!" Ugh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: You're wrong!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You refuse to lose even when the odds
are
against you, and you never give up
no matter how
tough things are!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Your determination is what makes you so
cool!
You really inspire and encourage
me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
At least, that's what I've always thought
about
you, Taishin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: You're not my rival because you're small!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: You're my rival because you're you!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I can't even count the number of times
I've
flip-flopped between leaving or
waiting a little
longer for Нарита Таисин.

But just as the sun begins to set... she
appears.
Have you been here this whole time?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: You mean, like, every day?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Why do you have so much faith in me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You've been like that ever since you
scouted me,
even though I don't have
the slightest bit of faith
in myself.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I just don't know what to do anymore. I...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Choosing not to race is a noble choice too.

text_block_list.text: No.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
No! I don't want to give up! As if I'd do
that right
now!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
But I don't know what to do! I'm not
proud of who
I am! I just see someone
revoltingly pathetic!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to believe that I'm
fine the
way I am—that I can continue to
race like this?
There's no way!

more.

next race.

things.
The Nikkei Sho?

Okay, I'll give it a shot.
